name: What is the approximate cost of installing a new walkway?

mainEntity.name: What is the approximate cost of installing a new walkway?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of installing a new walkway is influenced by several factors, including the material choice, linear footage, design complexity, site preparation requirements, and accessibility. Pavers or concrete typically range from $15 to $30 per square foot, while natural stone options like flagstone can cost $25 to $50 per square foot or more due to material and labor specifics. A detailed estimate is provided after an on-site consultation to assess your specific project needs and preferences.
acceptedAnswer.description: Walkway installation costs vary widely based on material, size, and design complexity. Pavers and concrete are generally $15-30/sq ft, while natural stone can be $25-50+/sq ft.
